title: Array and Simple Queries
description: Given two numbers N and M. N indicates the number of elements in the array A[1-indexed] and M indicates number of queries. You are given M queries. Queries can be of two types, type 1 and type 2. Perform two types of queries on the array A[]: Type 1: remove elements from i to j and add them to the front. Type 2: remove elements from i to j and add them to the back. Print |A[1] - A[N]| of the resulting array after the execution of M queries followed by the resulting array.
input_format: First line consists of two space-separated integers, N and M. Second line contains N integers, which represent the elements of the array. M queries follow. Each line contains a query of either type 1 or type 2 in the form type i j
output_format: Print the absolute value abs(A[1] - A[N]) in the first line. Print elements of the resulting array in the second line, each element separated by a single space.
